title: Law enforcement cooperation.
bodyText: The attorney general, and the chief of police and prosecuting attorney of each county, shall cooperate with the department in establishing and maintaining the system.
bodyHtml: [§353-135]  Law enforcement cooperation.  The attorney general, and the chief of police and prosecuting attorney of each county, shall cooperate with the department in establishing and maintaining the system. [L 2012, c 190, pt of §1]
